blocks.text: Why Standard Roll Holders Fail in Multi-Stall Commercial Offices

A conventional commercial standard roll of 2-ply bath tissue—such as Angel Soft Professional Series 2-Ply Embossed Toilet Paper (450 sheets per individually wrapped roll, 80 rolls per case)—is an excellent amenity for single-occupant executive washrooms, boutique law firms, or private medical suites where domestic plushness is prized. However, placing a single or dual standard 450-sheet roll spindle inside a high-traffic corridor stall shared by 35 to 60 office employees creates a daily operational bottleneck.

Because a 450-sheet roll contains only about 150 linear feet of tissue, a busy stall consumes an entire roll in 6 to 8 business hours. If your office runs on an evening-only janitorial contract—whether Daily Weekdays (5x/week = 21.65 visits/month at a 0.90 multiplier) or 3 Times Weekly (3x/week = 13.0 visits/month at a 0.95 multiplier)—nobody is on site at 1:30 PM to reload an empty spindle unless you pay for day-porter labor at $35 to $65 per hour. Worse, night cleaners servicing restrooms at $15 to $30 per fixture group per visit are forced to either pull off half-used standard rolls and stack them awkwardly on the Partition ledge (where they get splashed or knocked onto wet ceramic tile) or discard 20% of your tissue budget as premature stub waste.

blocks.text: How the Sliding Infinity-Transfer Gate Eliminates Stub-Roll Waste

The single most important mechanical component inside the San Jamar Classic Oceans Twin 9-Inch Jumbo Tissue Dispenser (R4000 series) is its sliding dual-chamber access door. Unlike side-by-side open dual roll holders where users randomly pull from both rolls at once—leaving the evening custodian with two half-depleted rolls that might both run out the following afternoon—the Twin 9-Inch JRT uses a locking sliding gate.

The sliding gate physically covers the fresh backup 9-inch roll until the primary roll is 100% exhausted down to its 3.25-inch cardboard core. The moment the primary roll finishes, the stall occupant simply slides the bottom access panel laterally to expose the fresh 1,000-foot backup roll. When the evening janitorial crew arrives, they never have to guess whether a partial roll will survive tomorrow's shift: they replace only the empty spindle core, slide the gate, and lock the cover. Furthermore, because the Classic Oceans cover is molded from translucent high-impact plastic, the cleaner verifies both roll diameters in two seconds without inserting a key.

items: Universal 3.25-Inch Core Freedom: Standard commercial JRT Jr. 9-inch rolls across virtually all US paper mills utilize a 3.25-inch (3.3-inch) inner core diameter. Because the San Jamar Classic Oceans mandates zero proprietary core notches, your facility or janitorial vendor can buy any 2-ply 1,000-ft or 1-ply 2,000-ft 9-inch jumbo case on the open market.

When to Stock Wrapped Standard Rolls Instead: In an under-2,500 sq ft office ($0.12 to $0.20/sq ft cleaning rate, $90 to $135 minimum visit charge) or an executive private washroom with residential-style chrome hardware, a 19-inch-wide twin jumbo cabinet looks industrial. Stocking an 80-roll case of individually wrapped Angel Soft Professional Series 2-Ply (450 sheets/roll) allows cleaners to leave a sealed, sanitary backup roll in the vanity cabinet without dust or moisture contamination.

ADA Stall Mounting Geometry: Under ADA Section 604.7, toilet paper dispensers in accessible stalls must be mounted 7 to 9 inches in front of the water closet rim, with the paper outlet positioned between 15 inches and 48 inches above the finished floor. Always select a continuous-flow JRT cabinet that does not control delivery with a spring stop, which is prohibited by ADA accessibility standards.

Synchronize Vanity Refills: Pair Twin 9-inch JRT stall hardware with a 1,200 mL GOJO TFX Touch-Free Foam Soap Dispenser (2,000+ washes) and either 800-foot Georgia-Pacific enMotion 10-Inch towel rolls or a 525-sheet Bobrick B-262 stainless folded dispenser so all restroom consumables deplete on matching multi-day intervals.

blocks.text: Matching Tissue Capacity to Janitorial Frequency Multipliers

Let's walk through the actual consumption math for an office floor with 40 onsite employees cleaned under different weekly visit frequencies (calculated at 4.33 weeks per month). Each employee uses an average of 125 linear feet of 2-ply bath tissue per month—meaning 40 employees consume 5,000 linear feet per month across your stalls.

If your facility contracts for **Weekly (1x/week = 4.33 visits/month, 1.08x rate multiplier)** or **Twice Weekly (2x/week = 8.66 visits/month, 1.00x multiplier)** janitorial service, your stalls must survive 3 to 5 full business days between custodian visits. A standard 450-sheet roll (150 linear feet) would run dry before Tuesday lunch. By installing a Twin 9-Inch Jumbo Dispenser holding 2,000 linear feet per stall across two stalls (4,000 linear feet total loaded capacity), your restrooms hold more than three weeks of tissue capacity at any given moment—completely eliminating emergency mid-week refill calls.

blocks.title: ADA Section 604.7 & Partition Backing Compliance
blocks.text: When mounting a 19-inch-wide Twin 9-Inch JRT dispenser onto phenolic, powder-coated steel, or laminate toilet partitions, never use bare sheet-metal screws that protrude through to the adjacent stall and snag clothing. Use through-bolt partition sex-bolts (barrel nuts) with smooth rounded heads, and verify the bottom paper outlet sits at least 15 inches above the ceramic tile floor and 12 inches clear of any grab bar to satisfy ADA Section 609.3.

faqs.q: How many standard rolls of toilet paper equal one 9-inch jumbo commercial roll?
faqs.a: A standard commercial 2-ply roll (such as a 450-sheet Angel Soft Professional roll) contains roughly 150 linear feet of tissue. A single 9-inch 2-ply Jumbo Roll Tissue (JRT Jr.) spool contains 1,000 linear feet—equal to 6.6 standard rolls. Therefore, a Twin 9-Inch Jumbo Dispenser loaded with two 1,000-foot rolls holds the equivalent of more than 13 standard rolls (or over 26 standard rolls if loaded with 2,000-foot 1-ply JRT spools).

faqs.q: Does the San Jamar Classic Oceans Twin 9-Inch dispenser require proprietary Tork or Georgia-Pacific tissue rolls?
faqs.a: No. The San Jamar Classic Oceans Twin 9-Inch Jumbo Tissue Dispenser is 100% universal and non-proprietary. It accepts any manufacturer's 9-inch diameter JRT Jr. roll with an industry-standard 3.25-inch (3.3-inch) inner core diameter.

faqs.q: Why do janitorial contractors charge $15 to $30 per restroom per visit on top of base square-footage rates?
faqs.a: Restrooms are the most labor- and chemical-intensive zones in an office building. While open carpeted office space (1.00x flooring multiplier) can be vacuumed at ISSA benchmark speeds near 3,500 sq ft/hour, restroom servicing requires EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectant dwell times on porcelain fixtures, high-touch partition latches, mirror detailing, trash liner changes, ceramic tile and grout scrubbing (1.12x flooring multiplier), and multi-cabinet consumable restocking.

faqs.q: When is it better to buy an 80-roll case of individually wrapped standard toilet paper instead of 9-inch jumbo rolls?
faqs.a: Individually wrapped 2-ply embossed standard rolls (such as the 80-roll case of 450-sheet Angel Soft Professional Series) are ideal when your office has residential-style spring spindles in single-occupant restrooms, executive suites, or small offices under 2,500 sq ft where wall space cannot accommodate a 19-inch-wide twin jumbo housing. The individual paper wrapper keeps spare rolls hygienically sealed when stacked in under-sink cabinets.
